verses.original: וַיֹּ֙סֶף֙ אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה לַחֲר֖וֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֨סֶת אֶת־ דָּוִ֤ד בָּהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֵ֛ךְ מְנֵ֥ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ’ap̄- Yah·weh la·ḥă·rō·wṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·seṯ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ bā·hem lê·mōr lêḵ mə·nêh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Again the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He stirred up David against them saying Go and take a census of Israel and Judah
verses.literalPt: Tornou-se, de novo, a acender a ira de Jeová contra Israel e incitou contra eles a Davi, dizendo: Vai, numera a Israel e a Judá.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל־ יוֹאָ֣ב׀ שַׂר־ הַחַ֣יִל אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֗וֹ שֽׁוּט־ נָ֞א בְּכָל־ שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִדָּן֙ וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וּפִקְד֖וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וְיָ֣דַעְתִּ֔י אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר הָעָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- yō·w·’āḇ śar- ha·ḥa·yil ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw šūṭ- nā bə·ḵāl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl mid·dān wə·‘aḏ- bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ū·p̄iq·ḏū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·yā·ḏa‘·tî ’êṯ mis·par hā·‘ām
verses.literal: So the king said to Joab the commander of his army who was with him Go now throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and register the troops so that I may know their number . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse o rei a Joabe, general do seu exército: Corre todas as tribos de Israel, desde Dã até Berseba, e fazei resenha do povo, para que eu saiba o número do povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹאָ֜ב אֶל־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיוֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ אֶל־ הָעָ֜ם כָּהֵ֤ם׀ וְכָהֵם֙ מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים וְעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ רֹא֑וֹת וַאדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֥מָּה חָפֵ֖ץ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·’āḇ ’el- ham·me·leḵ wə·yō·w·sêp̄ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’el- hā·‘ām kā·hêm wə·ḵā·hêm mê·’āh p̄ə·‘ā·mîm wə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî- ham·me·leḵ rō·’ō·wṯ wa·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ lām·māh ḥā·p̄êṣ bad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: But Joab replied to the king May the LORD your God . . . multiply the troops a hundred times over . . . and may the eyes of my lord the king see it But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing
verses.literalPt: Joabe respondeu ao rei: Queira Jeová, teu Deus, multiplicar o povo cem vezes mais do que agora é, e veja-o o rei, meu senhor! Mas por que tem prazer nisso o rei, meu senhor?

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק דְּבַר־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶל־ יוֹאָ֔ב וְעַ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל וַיֵּצֵ֨א יוֹאָ֜ב וְשָׂרֵ֤י הַחַ֙יִל֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לִפְקֹ֥ד אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq də·ḇar- ham·me·leḵ ’el- yō·w·’āḇ wə·‘al śā·rê he·ḥā·yil way·yê·ṣê yō·w·’āḇ wə·śā·rê ha·ḥa·yil lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ lip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Nevertheless , the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the commanders of the army So Joab and the commanders of the army departed from the presence of the king to register the troops of Israel
verses.literalPt: Todavia, a palavra do rei prevaleceu contra Joabe e contra os generais do exército. Saiu da presença do rei Joabe, com os generais do exército a contar o povo de Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְר֖וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בַעֲרוֹעֵ֗ר יְמִ֥ין הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֥חַל הַגָּ֖ד וְאֶל־ יַעְזֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇa·‘ă·rō·w·‘êr yə·mîn hā·‘îr ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ- han·na·ḥal hag·gāḏ wə·’el- ya‘·zêr
verses.literal: They crossed the Jordan and camped near Aroer south of the town in the middle of the valley and proceeded toward Gad . . . and Jazer
verses.literalPt: Tendo eles passado o Jordão, acamparam-se em Aroer, ao lado direito da cidade que está no meio do vale de Gade, indo até Jazer.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔דָה וְאֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֖ים חָדְשִׁ֑י וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ דָּ֣נָה יַּ֔עַן וְסָבִ֖יב אֶל־ צִידֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū hag·gil·‘ā·ḏāh wə·’el- ’e·reṣ taḥ·tîm ḥā·ḏə·šî way·yā·ḇō·’ū dā·nāh ya·‘an wə·sā·ḇîḇ ’el- ṣî·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: Then they went to Gilead and the land of Tahtim-hodshi and on to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon
verses.literalPt: Em seguida, foram a Gileade e à terra de Tatim-Hodchi; foram a Dã-Jaã, dali virando-se para Sidom,

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִבְצַר־ צֹ֔ר וְכָל־ עָרֵ֥י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י וַיֵּֽצְא֛וּ אֶל־ נֶ֥גֶב יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū miḇ·ṣar- ṣōr wə·ḵāl ‘ā·rê ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî way·yê·ṣə·’ū ’el- ne·ḡeḇ yə·hū·ḏāh bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: They went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the cities of the Hivites and Canaanites Finally, they went on to the Negev of Judah to Beersheba
verses.literalPt: chegaram à fortaleza de Tiro, e a todas as cidades dos heveus e dos cananeus; e acabaram a viagem no Neguebe de Judá, em Berseba.

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֖טוּ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ מִקְצֵ֨ה תִשְׁעָ֧ה חֳדָשִׁ֛ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים י֖וֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ṭū bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·ḇō·’ū miq·ṣêh ṯiš·‘āh ḥo·ḏā·šîm wə·‘eś·rîm yō·wm yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: At the end of nine months and twenty days having gone through the whole land they returned to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Tendo corrido toda a terra, chegaram a Jerusalém ao fim de nove meses e vinte dias.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת־ מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד־ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתְּהִ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שְׁמֹנֶה֩ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף אִֽישׁ־ חַ֙יִל֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב וְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên yō·w·’āḇ ’eṯ- mis·par mip̄·qaḏ- hā·‘ām ’el- ham·me·leḵ wat·tə·hî yiś·rā·’êl šə·mō·neh mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ’îš- ḥa·yil šō·lêp̄ ḥe·reḇ wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh ḥă·mêš- mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: And Joab reported to the king the total number of the troops . . . In Israel there were 800,000 . . . . . . men of valor who drew the sword and in Judah there were 500,000 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Deu Joabe ao rei a soma do recenseamento do povo. Havia em Israel oitocentos mil homens valentes que puxavam da espada, e em Judá eram quinhentos mil.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤ךְ לֵב־ דָּוִד֙ אֹת֔וֹ אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן סָפַ֣ר אֶת־ הָעָ֑םס וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה חָטָ֤אתִי מְאֹד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַֽעֲבֶר־ נָא֙ אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן עַבְדְּךָ֔ כִּ֥י נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ lêḇ- dā·wiḏ ’ō·ṯōw ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên sā·p̄ar ’eṯ- hå̄·ʿå̄·ms way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- Yah·weh ḥā·ṭā·ṯî mə·’ōḏ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ha·‘ă·ḇer- nā ’eṯ- ‘ă·wōn ‘aḇ·də·ḵā kî nis·kal·tî mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: After . . . David had numbered the troops his conscience was stricken and he said to the LORD I have sinned greatly in what I have done Now O LORD I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant for I have acted very foolishly
verses.literalPt: O coração de Davi o acusou, depois de ter ele numerado o povo. Disse Davi a Jeová: Muito pequei no que fiz; porém agora, Jeová, rogo-te que perdoes a iniquidade do teu servo, porque procedi muito nesciamente.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥קָם דָּוִ֖ד בַּבֹּ֑קֶר פ וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל־ גָּ֣ד הַנָּבִ֔יא חֹזֵ֥ה דָוִ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām dā·wiḏ bab·bō·qɛr p̄ ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’el- gāḏ han·nā·ḇî ḥō·zêh ḏā·wiḏ lê·mōr
verses.literal: When David got up in the morning the word of the LORD had come to Gad the prophet David’s . . . seer
verses.literalPt: Levantando-se Davi pela manhã, veio a palavra de Jeová ao profeta Gade, vidente de Davi, dizendo:

verses.original: הָל֞וֹךְ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֶל־ דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׁלֹ֕שׁ אָנֹכִ֖י נוֹטֵ֣ל עָלֶ֑יךָ בְּחַר־ לְךָ֥ אַֽחַת־ מֵהֶ֖ם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’el- dā·wiḏ kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh šā·lōš ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·w·ṭêl ‘ā·le·ḵā bə·ḥar- lə·ḵā ’a·ḥaṯ- mê·hem wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says I am offering . . . you three options Choose one of them and I will carry it out against you
verses.literalPt: Vai e fala a Davi: Assim diz Jeová: Três coisas te ofereço; escolhe qual delas queres que te faça.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא־ גָ֥ד אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֡וֹ הֲתָב֣וֹא לְךָ֣ שֶֽׁבַע שָׁנִ֣ים׀ רָעָ֣ב׀ בְּאַרְצֶ֡ךָ אִם־ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳ֠דָשִׁים נֻסְךָ֨ לִפְנֵֽי־ צָרֶ֜יךָ וְה֣וּא רֹדְפֶ֗ךָ וְאִם־ הֱ֠יוֹת שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֥ים דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּאַרְצֶ֔ךָ עַתָּה֙ דַּ֣ע וּרְאֵ֔ה מָה־ אָשִׁ֥יב שֹׁלְחִ֖י דָּבָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō- ḡāḏ ’el- dā·wiḏ way·yag·geḏ- lōw way·yō·mer lōw hă·ṯā·ḇō·w lə·ḵā še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm rā·‘āḇ bə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā ’im- šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm nus·ḵā lip̄·nê- ṣā·re·ḵā wə·hū rō·ḏə·p̄e·ḵā wə·’im- hĕ·yō·wṯ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm de·ḇer bə·’ar·ṣe·ḵā ‘at·tāh da‘ ū·rə·’êh māh- ’ā·šîḇ šō·lə·ḥî dā·ḇār
verses.literal: So Gad went and said to David - Do you choose to endure . . . three years of famine in your land three months of fleeing the pursuit of your enemies or three days of plague upon your land Now then think it over and decide how I should reply . . . to Him who sent me
verses.literalPt: Gade, indo ter com Davi, lho intimou e disse: Queres que te venham sete anos de fome na tua terra? Ou queres fugir por três meses diante dos teus inimigos, enquanto estes te perseguirem? Ou que haja por três dias peste na tua terra? Delibera, agora, e vê que resposta hei de levar a quem me enviou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֶל־ גָּ֖ד צַר־ לִ֣י מְאֹ֑ד נִפְּלָה־ נָּ֤א בְיַד־ יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֣ים רַחֲמוֹ וּבְיַד־ אָדָ֖ם אַל־ אֶפֹּֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- gāḏ ṣar- lî mə·’ōḏ nip·pə·lāh- nā ḇə·yaḏ- Yah·weh kî- rab·bîm ra·ḥă·mō ū·ḇə·yaḏ- ’ā·ḏām ’al- ’ep·pō·lāh
verses.literal: David . . . answered Gad I am deeply distressed Please let us fall into the hand of the LORD for His mercies are great but do not let me fall into the hands of men
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Davi a Gade: Acho-me em grande aperto. Caiamos nas mãos de Jeová, porque muitas são as suas misericórdias; porém nas mãos dos homens não caia eu.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵהַבֹּ֖קֶר וְעַד־ עֵ֣ת מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיָּ֣מָת מִן־ הָעָ֗ם מִדָּן֙ וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên Yah·weh de·ḇer bə·yiś·rā·’êl mê·hab·bō·qer wə·‘aḏ- ‘êṯ mō·w·‘êḏ way·yā·māṯ min- hā·‘ām mid·dān wə·‘aḏ- bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel from that morning until the appointed time and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to Beersheba died
verses.literalPt: Então, enviou Jeová a peste a Israel, desde a manhã até o tempo determinado; e morreram do povo, desde Dã até Berseba, setenta mil homens.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ יָד֨וֹ הַמַּלְאָ֥ךְ׀ יְרֽוּשָׁלִַם֮ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ֒ וַיִּנָּ֤חֶם יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה וַ֠יֹּאמֶר לַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ הַמַּשְׁחִ֤ית בָּעָם֙ רַ֔ב עַתָּ֖ה הֶ֣רֶף יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ הָיָ֔ה עִם־ גֹּ֖רֶן הָאוֹרְנָה הַיְבֻסִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw ham·mal·’āḵ yə·rū·šā·lim lə·ša·ḥă·ṯāh way·yin·nā·ḥem Yah·weh ’el- hā·rā·‘āh way·yō·mer lam·mal·’āḵ ham·maš·ḥîṯ bā·‘ām raḇ ‘at·tāh he·rep̄ yā·ḏe·ḵā ū·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh hā·yāh ‘im- gō·ren hå̄·ʾō·rə·nå̄h hay·ḇu·sî
verses.literal: But when the angel stretched out his hand to destroy Jerusalem the LORD relented from the calamity and said to the angel who was destroying the people Enough Withdraw your hand now At that time the angel of the LORD was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite
verses.literalPt: Quando o Anjo estendeu a mão sobre Jerusalém para a destruir, arrependeu-se do mal Jeová e disse ao Anjo que exterminava ao povo: Basta; detém, agora, a tua mão. O Anjo de Jeová estava junto à eira de Araúna, jebuseu.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶל־ יְהוָ֜ה בִּרְאֹת֣וֹ׀ אֶֽת־ הַמַּלְאָ֣ךְ׀ הַמַּכֶּ֣ה בָעָ֗ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י חָטָ֙אתִי֙ וְאָנֹכִ֣י הֶעֱוֵ֔יתִי וְאֵ֥לֶּה הַצֹּ֖אן מֶ֣ה עָשׂ֑וּ תְּהִ֨י נָ֥א יָדְךָ֛ בִּ֖י וּבְבֵ֥ית אָבִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- Yah·weh bir·’ō·ṯōw ’eṯ- ham·mal·’āḵ ham·mak·keh ḇā·‘ām way·yō·mer hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî ḥā·ṭā·ṯî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî he·‘ĕ·wê·ṯî wə·’êl·leh haṣ·ṣōn meh ‘ā·śū tə·hî nā yā·ḏə·ḵā bî ū·ḇə·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: When David saw the angel striking down the people . . . he said to the LORD Surely I, the shepherd have sinned and acted wickedly But these sheep what have they done Please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house
verses.literalPt: Davi, quando viu ao Anjo que feriu o povo, falou a Jeová: Eis que eu pequei e eu procedi perversamente, porém estas ovelhas que fizeram? Seja a tua mão contra mim e contra a casa de meu pai.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא־ גָ֥ד אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ עֲלֵה֙ הָקֵ֤ם לַֽיהוָה֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּגֹ֖רֶן אָרָנְיָה הַיְבֻסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō- ḡāḏ ’el- dā·wiḏ bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yō·mer lōw ‘ă·lêh hā·qêm Yah·weh miz·bê·aḥ bə·ḡō·ren ʾå̄·rå̄·nə·yå̄h hay·ḇu·sî
verses.literal: And that day Gad came to David and said to him Go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite
verses.literalPt: Veio Gade, naquele dia, ter com Davi e disse-lhe: Sobe e levanta um altar a Jeová na eira de Araúna, jebuseu.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַל דָּוִד֙ כִּדְבַר־ גָּ֔ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al dā·wiḏ kiḏ·ḇar- gāḏ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: So David went up at the word of Gad just as the LORD had commanded
verses.literalPt: Davi subiu conforme a palavra de Gade, como Jeová ordenou.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁקֵ֣ף אֲרַ֗וְנָה וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֶת־ עֲבָדָ֔יו עֹבְרִ֖ים עָלָ֑יו וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֲרַ֔וְנָה וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·qêp̄ ’ă·raw·nāh way·yar ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ‘ā·lāw way·yê·ṣê ’ă·raw·nāh way·yiš·ta·ḥū lam·me·leḵ ’ap·pāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: When Araunah looked out and saw the king and his servants coming toward him he went out and bowed facedown . . . before the king
verses.literalPt: Olhou Araúna, e, vendo que vinham ter com ele o rei e seus servos, saiu, e prostrou-se perante o rei com o rosto em terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲרַ֔וְנָה מַדּ֛וּעַ בָּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לִקְנ֧וֹת מֵעִמְּךָ֣ אֶת־ הַגֹּ֗רֶן לִבְנ֤וֹת מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְתֵעָצַ֥ר הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·raw·nāh mad·dū·a‘ bā ’ă·ḏō·nî- ham·me·leḵ ’el- ‘aḇ·dōw way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ liq·nō·wṯ mê·‘im·mə·ḵā ’eṯ- hag·gō·ren liḇ·nō·wṯ miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh wə·ṯê·‘ā·ṣar ham·mag·gê·p̄āh mê·‘al hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Why has my lord the king come to his servant Araunah said To buy your threshing floor . . . David replied that I may build an altar to the LORD so that the plague upon the people may be halted
verses.literalPt: Perguntou: Por que vem o rei, meu senhor, ter com o seu servo? Respondeu Davi: Para comprar de ti a eira, para edificar um altar a Jeová, a fim de que cesse dentre o povo a praga.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲרַ֙וְנָה֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד יִקַּ֥ח וְיַ֛עַל אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינוֹ רְאֵה֙ הַבָּקָ֣ר לָעֹלָ֔ה וְהַמֹּרִגִּ֛ים וּכְלֵ֥י הַבָּקָ֖ר לָעֵצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·raw·nāh ’el- dā·wiḏ yiq·qaḥ wə·ya·‘al ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·ʿē·nō rə·’êh hab·bā·qār lā·‘ō·lāh wə·ham·mō·rig·gîm ū·ḵə·lê hab·bā·qār lā·‘ê·ṣîm
verses.literal: Araunah said to David May my lord the king take whatever seems good to him and offer it up Here are the oxen for a burnt offering and the threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood
verses.literalPt: Araúna disse a Davi: Tome, e sacrifique o rei, meu senhor, o que bem lhe parecer; eis os bois para o holocausto, e os trilhos, e os aparelhos dos bois para a lenha.

verses.original: הַכֹּ֗ל נָתַ֛ן אֲרַ֥וְנָה הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְס וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲרַ֙וְנָה֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יִרְצֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kōl nā·ṯan ’ă·raw·nāh ham·me·leḵ lam·mɛ·lɛḵs way·yō·mer ’ă·raw·nāh ’el- ham·me·leḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yir·ṣe·ḵā
verses.literal: O king Araunah gives all these to the king He also said to the king May the LORD your God accept you
verses.literalPt: Tudo isso, ó rei, Araúna te oferece. Disse Araúna ao rei: Que Jeová, teu Deus, te aceite!

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל־ אֲרַ֗וְנָה לֹ֚א כִּֽי־ קָנ֨וֹ אֶקְנֶ֤ה מֵאֽוֹתְךָ֙ בִּמְחִ֔יר וְלֹ֧א אַעֲלֶ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖י עֹל֣וֹת חִנָּ֑ם וַיִּ֨קֶן דָּוִ֤ד אֶת־ הַגֹּ֙רֶן֙ וְאֶת־ הַבָּקָ֔ר בְּכֶ֖סֶף שְׁקָלִ֥ים חֲמִשִּֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- ’ă·raw·nāh lō kî- qā·nōw ’eq·neh mê·’ō·wṯ·ḵā bim·ḥîr wə·lō ’a·‘ă·leh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay ‘ō·lō·wṯ ḥin·nām way·yi·qen dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- hag·gō·ren wə·’eṯ- hab·bā·qār bə·ḵe·sep̄ šə·qā·lîm ḥă·miš·šîm
verses.literal: No replied the king - I insist on paying . . . a price for I will not offer to the LORD my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver
verses.literalPt: Então, disse o rei a Araúna: Não; porém to comprarei pelo que vale; não oferecerei a Jeová, meu Deus, holocaustos que me não custem nada. Comprou Davi a eira e os bois por cinquenta siclos de prata.

verses.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ שָׁ֨ם דָּוִ֤ד מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עֹל֖וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֑ים וַיֵּעָתֵ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ וַתֵּעָצַ֥ר הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen šām dā·wiḏ miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh way·ya·‘al ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·šə·lā·mîm way·yê·‘ā·ṯêr Yah·weh lā·’ā·reṣ wat·tê·‘ā·ṣar ham·mag·gê·p̄āh mê·‘al yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings Then the LORD answered the prayers on behalf of the land and the plague upon Israel was halted
verses.literalPt: Edificou ali um altar a Jeová e ofereceu holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas. Assim, Jeová se tornou propício para com a terra, e a praga cessou de Israel.
